name: tuktakbazaar
description: Tuktak Bazaar — a single-vendor e-commerce platform for Bangladesh with Daraz-style features

scripts.setup: npm run db:generate -w apps/api && npm run db:deploy -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
